project.title: Enhancing Nitrogen Removal from Low C/N Municipal Wastewater via Redistributing Hydraulic Retention Time in a Pilot-Scale Anaerobic/Oxic/Anoxic Process
project.description: the study intended to identify the enrichment of glycogen accumulating organisms (GAOs) and nitrifying bacteria. Test results demonstrated that Rhodocyclaceae rose from 0.38% (inoculated sludge) to 3.06% at day 164, while Nitrospira climbed from 0.97% to 2.92%. In summary, rearranging AOA HRT enhances endogenous denitrification, offering a feasible retrofit method for low-C/N sewage treatment.

runs: 16S rRNA gene (V1V9 regions) amplicon sequencing of AOA process activated sludge
